text.title: Quality Gates Decision Tree
text.summary: Preconditions first (readiness-checklist in use, CI exists, a user-facing or API surface exists), then the layers the git diff touches route to the matrix row. Every conclusion references a rule id from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the project use readiness-checklist, have CI (lint + typecheck + unit minimum), and expose a user-facing or API surface somewhere in the codebase — and is it neither a throwaway prototype nor a pure-documentation project?

branch.conclusion: Throwaway prototype or pure-documentation project; or no readiness-checklist / CI to enforce a gate in. Skip.
Recompute the layers from the diff before looking anything up; the developer's self-assessment of scope is not an input.

branch.question: Which stack layers does the diff touch?

branch.conclusion: Unit + API tests. No Playwright, no UI audit. Tick or n/a each in readiness.md; CI runs them green.
Unit + API + Playwright happy path; UI audit if any visible UI changed — "cosmetic" is still visible.
Playwright positive AND negative cases per flow; UI audit if web / mobile / TUI.
Unit + Playwright pos+neg per flow. No API tests for this feature.
Unit + migration tests + reversibility check. No Playwright, no UI audit, no API tests.
Unit tests on any logic changed + a smoke check that build / deploy still produces a working artefact.
readiness.md is not proof of execution. CI must run every required gate and be green before the feature moves to done/.
A green run is not proof the assertions still exist. Tick each gate with an evidence link or n/a with a one-line reason.

text.example: inputs: {readiness_checklist=true, ci=true, layers_source=git-diff, layers=[backend, frontend, user-facing-flow]} q-preconditions -> true q-layers -> backend AND frontend; user-facing-flow => conclusions r-full-stack-gates + r-user-facing-flow-gates: unit, api, playwright happy, playwright pos+neg per flow, ui audit. readiness.md: five ticks with evidence; CI runs unit/api/playwright green -> move to done/.
